description: Header file defining the Philox random number generator engine implementation in PyTorch, including class 'philox_engine' with methods for seed initialization, state management, and random number generation.

classes.name: philox_engine
classes.description: Class implementing the Philox RNG engine with seed, state, and random number generation methods.

methods.name: reset_state
methods.description: Resets the engine's seed and subsequence state.

methods.name: set_offset
methods.description: Sets the current offset in the sequence.

methods.name: get_offset
methods.description: Retrieves the current offset in the sequence.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a 32-bit pseudo-random number, updating internal state.

methods.name: randn
methods.description: Generates a normally distributed random float using Box-Muller transform.

methods.name: incr_n
methods.description: Skips N 128-bit numbers in the sequence.

methods.name: incr
methods.description: Skips one 128-bit number in the sequence.
